title: Closed-back cup with a mesh-damped rear vent (theory-only example)
description: 40 mm driver with the Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32 primary set (fs 81.8 Hz, Qms 2.71, Qes 1.01, Re 32.8 ohm, Mms 0.3 g, Sd 10 cm2; Cms 12.6 mm/N, Rms 0.057 N.s/m and Bl 2.24 T.m derived from it, docs/spec-errata.md E5). The front cavity (radius 25 mm, depth 15 mm, 29.5 cm3) is a two-node depth line from the driver face to the ear face, sealed by the pad except for a narrow slit leak at the ear face. The 25 cm3 rear cavity breathes through a 3 mm hole in a 2 mm wall covered by a 160 MKS rayl woven mesh (the Saati Acoustex 160 grade the spec cites; 160 rayl over the 7.07 mm2 hole is 2.26e7 Pa.s/m3), which turns the rear Helmholtz resonance into a resistive leak with a corner near 40 Hz. The vent radiates from the cup shell, treated as a baffle. Geometry and leak are illustrative, not a measured product; there is no ear model, so p_ear is the pressure at the pad plane.
